kind: Post-hoc K group localization diagnostic, not deployable policy
selection: Fixed evenly spaced windows 1,5,9,13,17,21,25,29 from the frozen pool, same selection for both models, no outcome exclusions; all are previously observed.
controls: Window 1 pass-through and independent full-state oracle replay for each K intervention; all scientific arms on all eight windows
prior_control_failure: Attempt003 failed bitwise pass-through; attempt004 native repeat diverged at SDPA despite identical Q/K/V. Fixed backend is a disclosed diagnostic configuration, not canonical relabeling.
intervention: Only incomplete K group padding repeats last real token for extrema; codes/decode and META8 otherwise unchanged; an independently modified packed oracle and separate NumPy reference validate semantics. Padding is never attended.
execution: detached single H100; scientific retries zero

analysis.interpretation: Effects are interventions with propagated activation changes, not an additive loss decomposition. Report all individual paired effects and fraction of range-vs-exactK gap removed; no equivalence threshold.

arm_definitions.bf16: Exact K and V native cache
arm_definitions.range_real: K3 excludes artificial padding zeros; frozen V2/META8 and R4
arm_definitions.k_exact: All K exact; frozen V2/META8 and R4
arm_definitions.open_exact: Only unfinished old K group exact; completed K groups padding-exclusion K3; frozen V2/META8 and exact R4
arm_definitions.closed_exact: Only completed old K groups exact; unfinished K group padding-exclusion K3; frozen V2/META8 and exact R4

group_definition: For length N, old=max(N-4,0); completed=[0,32*floor(old/32)); unfinished=[32*floor(old/32),old); residual=[old,N). Reclassify each decode; exact unfinished tokens become quantized when their page closes in open_exact.
